name: BOATS AGAINST THE CURRENT
blurb: Sail a moonlit yacht toward the green light at the end of Daisy's dock as the restless Sound pushes back.
how: Move the mouse left or right to steer · the wind drives the sail · sum-of-sines ocean waves buffet the yacht · ESC for chapters

win.title: THE GREEN LIGHT
win.body: The sail fills and the yacht goes on; the light grows until it is a lamp on a wooden post, and the water is shallow enough to touch. {closest} Daisy's dock has never been this near.
win.quote: He stretched out his arms toward the dark water in a curious way.
win.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby

lose.title: BOATS AGAINST THE CURRENT
lose.body: The wind spends itself against the current and the dark keeps its distance. The green light burns at the end of Daisy's dock, exactly as far away as when you first raised the sail. {closest} The Sound carries the yacht back down the way it came, closing over the wake as though no one had ever crossed it.
lose.quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
lose.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby
